title: The scroll
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The strip is read on phones now. Wood watches a tourist scroll a Sunday vertically at Gully's counter. The page sliced.

panels.composition: Gully's. A TOURIST at the counter with a phone, thumb moving. WOOD on the stool beside her, close enough to see the screen. BARNABY II in the basket.

image.prompt: a tourist at a shop counter scrolling a phone with her thumb, a thin man on the next stool glancing at the screen, a three-legged dog in a basket on the counter, clean ink

panels.composition: The phone: 'The Carry.' Sliced into a vertical strip. Panel 4 — the drift log, the wide one — cropped to a square. The gulls gone. The sky gone.
props: phone screen showing a Sunday page cut into a vertical scroll

image.prompt: close-up of a phone screen showing a comic Sunday page chopped into a narrow vertical scroll, a wide panel cropped to a square with its sky and edges cut away
image.notes: 'The Carry' on a phone. Tier 4 cropped to a square: no gulls, no sky.

balloons.text: This one's sad. The dog one.

image.prompt: a tourist scrolling a phone without looking up while the man beside her says something quiet and then retracts it

panels.composition: Wood on the stool, drawing the tourist's thumb. Very precisely. Gully watching him draw it. The pup asleep.

image.prompt: a thin man on a shop stool drawing a tourist's thumb on a pad with great precision while a stocky man behind the counter watches him do it, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: The aggregator's scroll. 'It's wider than that.' He draws the thumb.
